_note: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (V): "has income taxable under section 115BBDA" (2017). Written as the rule writes it (W-090d C2a, D-652): whether any such income can arise in TY 2025-26 is the law's question, which the person answers; the engine computes none. The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2025-26 only: r.12(1) as in force for AY 2026-27; TY 2026-27's r.164(3) has no such item.
question: Do you have any income taxable under section 115BBDA of the Income-tax Act, 1961?

provenance.sourceDescription: egazette 2017/175133, Income-tax (Fourth Amendment) Rules, 2017, S.O. 1006(E), inserting Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso items (IV) – (VI), p.163
